verdict.rationale: AiPrise documents a fully hosted, customizable web verification flow that can be embedded, plus native mobile SDKs built for capture. Together these cover the core idea of not building capture UI yourself. However, the evidence never explicitly mentions document-plus-selfie or liveness capture, creating a session server-side, redirecting, or reading results back. Missing for 10: explicit document plus selfie/liveness coverage in the hosted flow, documented server-side session creation, a redirect or embed integration guide, a result retrieval API or callback, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch a complete document-plus-selfie verification with a hosted or drop-in flow — create a session server-side, redirect or embed, and read the result — without building capture UI myself

citations.quote: Embed user or business verification directly in your web applications with a fully hosted, customizable flow
Integrate verification into iOS and Android apps with native SDKs optimized for mobile capture and performance
